title: WhatsApp Business API 整合 — Webhook + 訊息收發
content:
建立 WhatsApp Business API 直接整合，作為獨立頻道（非網站可接近）。

任務：
1. WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) 設定
   - 建立/連結 Meta Business Manager
   - 設定 WhatsApp Business Account
   - 獲取 Permanent Access Token
   - 設定 Webhook URL

2. Webhook 端點 (POST /api/whatsapp/webhook)
   - Meta 驗證（GET — hub.verify_token 挑戰）
   - 接收 incoming messages (text)
   - 解析 message body、sender phone number
   - 將訊息送入 FAQ 匹配引擎取得回覆
   - 透過 WhatsApp Cloud API 發送回覆

3. 訊息發送模組 (src/lib/whatsapp/send.ts)
   - POST to https://graph.facebook.com/v18.0/{phone-number-id}/messages
   - 支援 text messages
   - 錯誤處理（rate limit、token 過期）

4. 環境變數
   - WHATSAPP_TOKEN (permanent access token)
   - WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
   - WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN (for webhook)
   - WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET

⚠️ 此卡只負責 WhatsApp 通訊層，FAQ 匹配邏輯共用 AF-005 的 matcher。
⚠️ 此功能需要 Meta Business Manager 與 WhatsApp Business Account 已設定。
acceptance: GET /api/whatsapp/webhook returns hub.challenge for Meta verification
POST /api/whatsapp/webhook receives incoming messages and returns 200 OK
Incoming text message triggers FAQ matching and sends reply via WhatsApp Cloud API
Message send module handles rate limiting and token expiry gracefully
All WhatsApp env vars documented in .env.example
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/api/whatsapp/webhook/route.ts (new — GET verify + POST receive webhook)
src/lib/whatsapp/send.ts (new — WhatsApp Cloud API message sender)
verification: Meta webhook verification passes. Send message to WhatsApp number → bot replies with FAQ answer. Verify with Meta webhook test tool.
